cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet a zkouška. Součástí zkoušky je E-learningový test v UIS v rozsahu 20ti otázek, pro splnění testu a postupu k ústní zkoušce je zapotřebí splnění nejméně 65%. Podmínkou ke získání zápočtu je vypracování průběžně zadávaných protokolů (zpravidla 1 protokol z každého cvičení), účast alespoň 80% na semestrálních cvičeních a 100% účast na hlavním cvičení. Součástí hlavního cvičení je zpracování projektu (polohopisný a výškopisný plán zájmového území, nivelační zápisník, technická zpráva měřické náčrty).

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowlege of the basic surveying methods. Students will get the basic information about survey mesurements, mappig, construction surveying, adjustments and computations with rectangular and polar coordinates and land records in CR. In the case of online lessons in the form of annotated lectures and manuals for exercises with consultations.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction and importance of the special suject. (allowance 4/2) a.Shape and dimension of the Earth. Earth ellipsoid.b.General coordinate systems.c.Spatial Coordinate Calculations. Cartesian Coordinates.d.Observational errors. Random quantity.e.Units of measurement.f.Preface to fartographic drawing. An overview of basic cartographic projection2.Coordinate geometry. (allowance 4/2) a.Computation of bearing and length of sight line.b.Computation of polar and orthogonal methods.c.Analytic area calculation.d.Polygonal traverse.3.Surveying methods. (allowance 16/20) a.Horizontal and vertical measuring of directions and angles, methods, accuracy. Data analysis - introduction.b.Surveying with use of simple devices. Orthogonal method, polar method.c.Linear measurement - taping, setting out of straight line, perpendicular, surveying chart. Electronic distance measurement.d.Tacheometry, contours and contour lines.Horizontal and vertical controls. Magnetic azimuth.e.Measuring with GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System)f.Introduction to Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) System.4.Land records. (allowance 4/4) a.History of Land Records in Czech Republic.b.Digital cadastral map. Elaboration of maps.c.Cadastral documentation.d.Utilization of the documantation to a Forest management plans.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The course is finished with written test and subsequent oral exam. For Credit you have to accomplish presence and records from practical lessons and from terrain exercise and for exam to receive minimal 65% from 20 questions in test and pass the oral exam (1 question, 10 minutes). Participation on test is compulsory.
